about: A team reads out quarterly numbers. Once all four are said, a bar chart shows the trend better than words; chatter before and after stays quiet.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Morning all. Let's start with the signup numbers since that's what the board will ask about.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: So Q1 we had 1,200 signups, Q2 was 1,850, Q3 jumped to 3,100, and this quarter we're at 4,400 with two weeks left.

lines.speaker: Dev
lines.text: Wow, so it's basically more than tripled since Q1. That's the story for the board.
